title: 日本ダービーの後に・完走！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket runs with everything she can muster, but ultimately fails to win the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Frustrated at letting her dream slip through her fingers, she bursts into tears.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Once she calms down, she comes to the happy realization that even though she lost, she still gave her fans the thrill of an incredible race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With a smile, she tells me that she'll show them another amazing race at the Kikuka Sho.
